entries.summary: Adds pure-white/pure-black redaction and rejects false absence. The palette, protected extent and accessible material treatment remain open; this entry selects no outline or gray background.
Adds the arc/ark/Noah association and resistance through existence/persistence. It is authorial meaning, not an etymological proof or a rule of indefinite retention.

Introduces rhetorical color, relabeling, click access to intensity, consent and the dove. U07 later explicitly excludes scalar presentation. Proof-conditioned diction and consent precedence remain human questions.
Extends the cache into human public argument and resolution. Does not supply a numerical saturation test, a collective governance procedure, or agreement as proof.
Adds welcoming, under-refined addressed localities. How hospitality relates to protocol errors and restricted resources remains a routing interpretation, not permission to fabricate content.

The author explicitly says intensity is not presented by a scalar and may be composed. This rules out a scalar interpretation of U04; U04 did not explicitly command a scalar. Preserve U04 rather than treating this narrower clarification as replacement of its entire turn. Safety, consent and proof-conditioned rhetoric still require their scoped interpretations.

Adds ark-held training, orientation rather than discovery, direct/proposal routing and address-bar intent-sity. Its suggested contrast/admission correspondence remains a question, not a demonstrated numerical identity or an inferred consent rule.

Commissions Hs, complete front/back matter and later interface only after philosophical completion. Haas/Hospital/House are authorial meanings. This is not acceptance of an edition, interpretation, license or deployment.

Requests examination of other repositories including their imperfections. Reading and agent synthesis are not adoption, a new private-source publication grant or evidence that their planned capabilities are implemented.
Requests issue extension and explicit marking of disagreements with human agency retained. The disagreement register and its new issues implement tracking, not resolution of the questions.
